name: schematic-planner
description: Plan on a Schematic Planner canvas instead of in Markdown: four skills that keep the design and the implementation plan in one graph both you and the agent are looking at.

interface.shortDescription: Plan in a graph you can point at, not a Markdown file nobody re-reads
interface.longDescription: Design and implementation plans live on a Schematic Planner canvas. The agent declares structure through MCP, leaves its open questions as comments on the drawing, and does not start building until you have answered them.
